fix_subject: In variant_extract correctly traverse child stats during stats propagation
pr_title: Otherwise all stats more than 2 levels deep get incorrectly labeled as

labels.summary: VariantStats::PushdownExtract did not descend into child stats (it never advanced the index iterator), so statistics for fields more than two levels deep were propagated and labeled incorrectly; the fix advances to child index 0 at each level.
